zeroconf_confirm.title: Add {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add {name} to Home Assistant? It pairs by itself, with nothing to type.

error.pairing_closed: This device has already been paired, and removing its Home Assistant entry does not reopen pairing. Reflash the device, then try again; next time, press its Factory reset button before removing it.
error.cert_mismatch: This device is presenting a different security certificate than the one Home Assistant recorded when it was added. That is expected if it has been factory-reset. If it has not been, something on your network may be impersonating it.
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the token it just handed over. Try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the device to identify it — it may still be starting up. It will be rediscovered automatically.
abort.discovery_only: Dashboard Assistant devices are added once Home Assistant discovers them on your network, and none has been found yet. Discovered devices show up on the [Dashboard Assistant integration page](/config/integrations/integration/dashboard_assistant), ready to add. A device that is on and on your network but never shows up is usually kept from mDNS by the network, for example by a separate VLAN.
abort.tls_required: This device does not offer an encrypted connection, so it cannot pair. Update its OS, then it is discovered again.

init.title: Pages
init.description: The pages this device shows. The first page is its home: it starts there, and its Home button goes back to it.

data_description.pages: Each page is a Home Assistant page or any website, in this order. The Page select and the next/previous buttons switch between them. Admin-only dashboards and apps are listed only if the device's user (dashboard-assistant-…) is an administrator, which you can change under Settings → People → Users. The device signs in to Home Assistant only, so other websites are shown signed out.

error.page_has_both: “{page}” has a Home Assistant page and a website. A page shows one of them, so clear the other.
error.page_has_neither: “{page}” has no Home Assistant page and no website. Pick one, or remove the page.
error.invalid_url: “{page}”: a website needs a full address starting with http:// or https://.
error.no_ha_url: “{page}”: Home Assistant has no URL the device can reach. Set one under Settings → System → Network, or add the page as a website.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Check it is on and try again.

abort.device_unavailable: The device is not connected, so its pages cannot be shown. Try again once it is back online.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shown in the Page select. Leave empty to use the Home Assistant page's name.

ha_page.name: Home Assistant page
ha_page.description: A dashboard, one of its tabs, or an app such as Music Assistant. Fill in this or Website, not both.

url.name: Website
url.description: Any website, starting with http:// or https://. Fill in this or Home Assistant page, not both.

no_earlier_generation.message: This device has only one system generation, so there is nothing to roll back to.
